validations.message: The gateway may create only an empty native ledger or one immutable enrollment/terminal v2 abort-barrier slot. Explicit current-group mode also permits immutable v2 pending records and bounded compiler seeds.
Authority records must use text data.
Native authority records cannot have garbage-collection owners.
Only the native Gateway may publish current-group pending records.
Pending records stay in the configured authority namespace.
One exact immutable ownerless canonical v2 pending record is required.
